title: Rotating API keys
text: Rotate an API key from Settings, API access. Generate the new key, deploy it, then revoke the old key. Keys are never shown twice.

title: Report exports and retention
text: Exported reports are retained for 30 days in the export bucket, after which they are deleted automatically. Retention is configurable on enterprise plans.

title: Single sign-on
text: The platform supports SSO through SAML 2.0 and OIDC. SCIM provisioning is available on enterprise plans. SSO is configured per workspace.

title: Rate limits
text: The default rate limit is 600 requests per minute per workspace. Bursts above the limit return HTTP 429 with a retry-after header.

title: Webhook delivery
text: Webhooks retry with exponential backoff for up to 24 hours. Delivery logs are available in the developer console for 7 days.
